name: Dagannoth

locations.name: Lighthouse
locations.how: Fairy ring ALP, after Horror from the Deep. Multicombat.
locations.note: 22 spawns; level 74 ones use ranged, level 92 use melee

locations.name: Jormungand's Prison
locations.how: Fremennik area, needs The Fremennik Exiles quest.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend (south)
locations.how: Enter the Catacombs of Kourend and head to the southern section.

gear.style: Melee or ranged (judgement); Earth spells also work

food.note: Max hit 10 and wiki calls them weak for their level; judgement on food.

tips: Lighthouse is multicombat so a cannon works well there.
No Slayer level needed.
Cannon cannot be used in the Catacombs.

name: Dust devils

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend (south-east)
locations.how: Fairy ring or teleport to Kourend, then enter the Catacombs. Multicombat with a safespot across water.

locations.name: Smoke Dungeon
locations.how: Needs Desert Treasure I started; Pollnivneach area. Task area is single-combat, multicombat area to the west.
locations.note: 44 spawns; no cannon in task area

locations.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
locations.how: North-east quadrant, Wilderness levels 25-28; entrance at level 29.
locations.note: 9 spawns; PvP risk, bring only what you can lose

mustBring: Facemask, Slayer helmet or Slayer helmet (i) (without it they always hit 16 and drain stats)

gear.style: Magic - barrage in multicombat; or ranged/melee

food.note: Max hit 8 with facemask; Protect from Melee helps.

tips: Attacks roll on your ranged defence.
Bring prayer potions and a rune pouch with water, blood, death runes for barraging.
Bracelet of slaughter or expeditious bracelet help.

name: Fire giants

locations.name: Charred Dungeon
locations.how: Only multicombat spawns; suitable for cannon.

food.note: Max hit only 11; judgement on food.

tips: 100% weakness to water spells.
Waterfall Dungeon has good safespots.
Rune scimitar drop (1/128).

name: Fossil Island Wyverns

locations.name: Wyvern Cave (northern, task-only)
locations.how: Digsite pendant to Fossil Island, Magic Mushtree to Mushroom Meadow, run south to the trapdoor in the Mushroom Forest. Needs Bone Voyage.

mustBring: Elemental, mind, dragonfire ward, dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield (cuts icy breath from 44 to 10; Anti-dragon shield does not work)
66 Slayer to damage wyverns (82 for ancient)

gear.style: Defensive armour; melee/ranged/magic with dragonbane weapons helping

food.note: Ancient wyvern icy breath hits up to 44 without shield, slash 16; wiki lists spitting breath 50+.

tips: Icy breath ignores prayers.
Ancient wyverns need Protect from Melee after de-aggroing them.
Use defensive armour rather than offensive.

name: Gargoyles

locations.name: Slayer Tower (top floor)
locations.how: Slayer ring to the Slayer Tower, climb stairs to the top floor, past the aberrant spectres.
locations.note: 8 spawns; safespot at the south-west doorway

locations.name: Slayer Tower (basement)
locations.how: Slayer Tower, go down to the basement; task-only (Raulyn blocks off-task).
locations.note: 12 spawns; safespot NE corner behind an immovable bucket; immune to poison

mustBring: Rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer (to finish them at 8 HP or less)
Slayer helmet or nose peg (aberrant spectres on the way to the top floor)

gear.style: Melee - slash (judgement); Earth spells also work

tips: Gargoyle Smasher perk (120 points) auto-smashes at 9 HP if you carry a rock hammer.
Granite hammer finishes automatically.
Bring High Level Alchemy runes.

name: Greater demons

locations.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
locations.note: 7 spawns; safespot at end of a vine NW of the stairs

tips: Protect from Melee needs 43 Prayer.
Safespots exist at several locations.
Drops rune full helm and hard clues.

name: Hellhounds

food.note: Max hit 11, 116 HP; judgement on food.

tips: Aggressive.
Hard clue drop 1/64.
2x2 so cannon works in most locations.

name: Jellies

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Slayer ring to the cave exit, or fairy ring AJR; entrance SE of Rellekka.
locations.note: 10 spawns; safespot at the southern rockfall

locations.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
locations.note: 14 spawns; cannons don't work; PvP risk

gear.style: Melee with high magic defence armour such as dragonhide

tips: Wear high magic defence, not metal armour.
Protect from Melee blocks all damage.
Safespot at corner rocks in the western area.

name: Kalphite

locations.name: Kalphite Cave
locations.how: Desert amulet 4, or fairy ring BIQ and run NE. Task-only. No rope needed.

locations.name: Kalphite Lair
locations.how: Rope needed. South of Shantay Pass/Al Kharid, or via fairy ring BIQ.
locations.note: No task required; workers 13, soldiers 7, guardians 4 spawns

food.note: Guardians hit 12; poison applies through Protect from Melee; judgement.

tips: Keris and variants work on all kalphites.
Antidote++ recommended.
Cannon in their chamber gives a very good XP rate.

name: Kurask
weakness: Slash/crush defence is +20; no elemental weakness stated

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Slayer ring to the cave exit, or fairy ring AJR.

mustBring: Leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows/bolts, or Magic Dart (only these damage them)

gear.style: Leaf-bladed melee, broad ammo or Magic Dart

tips: Safespots exist at each location.
Regenerate 1 HP every 5 ticks.
Immune to poison, venom, thralls.
